name: ascend-reborn
description: Unofficial fan-made web revival of Tribes: Ascend gameplay. Not affiliated with Hi-Rez Studios.

scripts.start: npm run build -w @ar/client && npm run start -w @ar/server
scripts.play: npm run build -w @ar/client && npm run start -w @ar/server -- --client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/master && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p tools/ta-import
